backproject_depth_to_3d_points: backproject a depth map to 3D world coordinates using camera intrinsics and extrinsics
project_3d_points_to_pixel_coords: project world 3D points to 2D pixel coordinates using camera intrinsics and extrinsics
convert_euclidean_depth_to_z_depth: convert euclidean depth values to z-depth values given camera intrinsics and image size
generate_colored_pointcloud_from_depth: generate a colored point cloud from depth and RGB frames with optional masking
build_opengl_projection_matrix: build an OpenGL projection matrix given field of view angles and near/far clipping planes
